commit_message: Add reproducible agent benchmark experiment core
pr_title: GameEngine: add reproducible local LLM benchmark experiments
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the GUI-free ADR0142 experiment foundation: exact experiment identity, deterministic 4x7xN planning, repository-owned fixture isolation/reset, single-model routing contamination checks, explicit unavailable/failure outcomes, machine-local result persistence, and model comparison summaries.

This is the first implementation slice; subsequent requests on the same Draft PR wire AI Studio orchestration and all seven executable scenarios before completion.
